task: Fix sidebar visual bug (misaligned ghost sliding indicator box overlapping WORKSPACE title and Dashboard link) and harmonize branding
rootCause: Sidebar component mounted an absolutely positioned sliding indicator div inside <nav className='space-y-5'>. When rendered conditionally after initial measurement, Tailwind's > :not([hidden]) ~ :not([hidden]) combinator inserted an unexpected 1.25rem margin-top on the Workspace section, misaligning the calculated coordinates and causing an empty rounded box to overlay WORKSPACE, while Dashboard also rendered a second duplicate active pill.

changes.summary: Removed fragile dynamic sliding indicator state and DOM node; relied on deterministic self-contained active pill in SidebarNavItem; upgraded brand monogram to BukSU Royal Blue and Academic Gold with COT department tag.
Playwright visual audit script covering dark mode, light mode, and collapsed rail mode.

verification.playwrightVisualAudit: Verified dark expanded, light expanded, and collapsed rail modes without visual artifacts.
